prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / style-transfer.
Create a distinctly new FEEL-GOOD V2 packaging render for TRAYN Radiance Cafe Latte, using the supplied selected pack as the brand reference. One photorealistic portrait 2:3 image.
Preserve the recognizable TRAYN symbol and TRAYN NUTRITION wordmark exactly, and preserve the selected expressive flowing dark coffee-brown Radiance lettering, including the distinctive large sweeping R. Keep the premium ivory cylindrical food tin, champagne-gold metal lid and rim, 500 g size and Cafe Latte flavor.
Make this a noticeably warmer, softer, more joyful DAILY RITUAL design. The product is for middle-aged and older men and women; communicate full everyday life and optimism with mature, gender-neutral taste. Beautiful premium food packaging, comfortable and welcoming.
LABEL V2:
- Shift the base from pale monochrome ivory/gold to luminous creamy ivory with soft apricot, mellow butter-yellow and delicate honey-gold accents. Maintain rich dark coffee-brown name and copy with clear contrast.
- Keep the TRAYN identity above the large stylized Radiance name and the clearly readable DAILY PROTEIN descriptor, but give the whole composition more relaxed breathing space.
- Reimagine the lower half as an original softly painted sunrise scene PRINTED ON THE TIN: a warm apricot rising sun, a gently rounded pale-honey horizon, soft sunlight moving through delicate coffee foliage. It should feel like a beautiful early morning, with subtle painterly grain, artistic nuance and generous open areas, not a generic gradient or racing ribbons. Retain restrained fine gold-foil details, with a few graceful rays rather than the source's densely geometric central sun medallion.
- Integrate an inviting beautifully hand-illustrated ceramic cafe latte cup and saucer into the lower-right artwork, creamy latte art clearly visible, a graceful wisp of steam, a few coffee beans and one small coffee blossom. Use warm terracotta, cream and coffee-brown shading, soft natural edges and convincing artisan illustration. Keep the illustration clearly printed on the label.
- Keep decorative coffee foliage quiet at the label edges, airy and organic. No dense botanical wallpaper.
- Place the flavor in a clear ivory pocket at lower left with Cafe Latte or CAFE LATTE on two readable lines, with 500 g and Contains Milk below.
- Preserve the small bottom notice PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE.
PHOTOGRAPHY:
One complete upright tin occupies about 72% of image height with comfortable breathing room. Set it on pale natural wood beside a sunlit breakfast window, soft apricot-gold morning light, beautifully diffused natural highlights and realistic soft shadows. A single unbranded cream ceramic cup of latte on a small saucer may sit in the lower left foreground, partly behind the tin edge without obscuring its label. One casually folded oatmeal linen napkin, faint out-of-focus green garden beyond the window. The mood is a quiet, lovely start to the day, premium but naturally lived-in. Crisp package and readable lettering, relaxed photographic background, believable print and material texture.
Exact required label words: TRAYN NUTRITION, Radiance, DAILY PROTEIN, CAFE LATTE, 500 g, Contains Milk, PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE. Do not add other slogans or copy.
No unsupported medical, diabetes, blood sugar, protein gram or nutrition claims; no certification badges, doctors, people, cartoon smiles or children's graphics. No changes to the TRAYN logo or selected Radiance wordmark. No chocolate artwork, extra packages, collage or comparison board.
formulationNote: Packaging and presentation exploration only; no formulation or medical suitability is established by the artwork.
